answer_1.quote: We propose to learn Neural Templates for Recommender Dialogue system, i.e., NTRD. NTRD is a neural approach that firstly generates a response "template" with slot locations explicitly tied to the recommended items ...
answer_1.outputs: response templates and final responses containing recommended items

answer_2.quote: For dialogue generation, automatic metrics include: (1) Fluency: perplexity (PPL) ... (2) Diversity: Distinct‑n ... For recommendation task, we introduce a new metric that checks whether the ground‑truth item is included in the final generated response, i.e., Recall@1 in Response (ReR@1) ... Item Diversity and Item Ratio are also reported.

answer_4.quote: Human evaluation. We report the human evaluation results ... three crowdworkers are employed to score on the generated responses in terms of Fluency and Informativeness. The range of score is 1 to 3.
answer_4.guideline: score on the generated responses in terms of Fluency and Informativeness
